neighbours.label: the word 'commercial' (commercial, Commercial, commercially; also Chinese 商业) in any sense
fire: The airport mainly handles commercial flights and some cargo planes.
Fishermen worry that commercial trawlers are emptying the bay.
The new battery is not yet commercially viable for small cars.
She works as a lawyer specialising in Commercial Law in Singapore.
During the game they showed a funny commercial for a soft drink.
The building has shops on the ground floor and commercial offices above.
Many farmers switched to commercial fertilisers in the 1950s.
The film was a commercial success but critics disliked it.
quiet: The airport mainly handles passenger flights and some cargo planes.
Fishermen worry that large trawlers are emptying the bay.
The new battery is not yet cheap enough for small cars.
She works as a lawyer specialising in contract disputes in Singapore.
During the game they showed a funny clip of a dancing fan.
The building has shops on the ground floor and flats above.
Many farmers switched to chemical fertilisers in the 1950s.
The film was a box office hit but critics disliked it.
